body_text:
Two formulas are logically equivalent when they have the same
truth value under every common interpretation and variable
assignment. Logical equivalence licenses replacement inside
larger formulas. Equality of mathematical objects is a
different, object-language relation and should not be conflated
with equivalence of formulas.
